plan.understanding: Add a 0.2 mm chamfer to the edges of the existing true hole mouths, i.e. the through-bore entry/exit rims used for fitting, and do not alter any other geometry.

subtasks.goal: Apply a 0.2 mm chamfer to all 12 existing through-hole rim edges: edge_idx [180,181,183,184,186,187,189,190] for the four d=0.8 holes (cylindrical faces #49,#50,#51,#52, axis [0.0,1.0,0.0]) and edge_idx [162,163,173,174] for the two d=1.5 holes (cylindrical faces #44,#46, axis [1.0,0.0,0.0]); chamfer both mouths of each hole equally and verify that only these sharp hole-entry edges are replaced, with the hole centers/axes unchanged.
